test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All carroms are ludos.

All ludos are scrabbles.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some carroms are not scrabbles.

II. Some scrabbles are carroms.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e8fc5e492cbfaa49cc6159d1bef107de52421c68c44d0bbe881659536d3f24c.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some carroms are not scrabbles → Does not follow (As all carroms are ludos and all ludos are scrabbles. As whole carroms comes in ludos which whole comes in scrabbles, thus whole carroms are scrabbles, therefore it is false.)

II) Some scrabbles are carroms → Follow (As all carroms are ludos and all ludos are scrabbles. As whole carroms comes in ludos which whole comes in scrabbles, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II ​follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
